# Site assets

Everything in this folder is publicly served once the site is deployed.

- Project screenshots: `arxiv.webp`, `documind.webp`, `biopredict.webp`, `notilytics.webp` (genuine, 16:9, ideally under 200 KB). Enable each one in `../site-config.js` → `screenshots`.
- Public résumé: `Darshil_Kalyani_Resume.pdf` (a concise, one-page public version). Enable it with `resumeUrl` in `../site-config.js`.

Do not put the internal master résumé, internship dossiers, API keys, or private files here.
